home.title: Prepare for a Gulf job, with a company you can check.
home.lead: Go Gulf counsels job seekers from India, helps prepare their profile and documents, and refers them to registered recruiting agents, who run the hiring with the employer. Any Go Gulf fee is quoted in writing before you pay.
home.askFirst: Not sure where to start? <wa>Talk to a counsellor on WhatsApp</wa>
home.whatsappGreeting: Hello Go Gulf, I have a question about working in the Gulf.

jobs.title: Gulf jobs open for applications
jobs.lead: Each job has its own page with the place, the details and how to apply. Applications are passed to the registered recruiting agent handling the job.

seekers.title: Looking for work in the Gulf?
seekers.lead: Apply for a listed job, or send a general application and talk to a counsellor.
seekers.point1: See the place, the job details and — where the employer has shared it — the salary before you apply.
seekers.point2: Ask about any job on WhatsApp — its reference goes with your message.
seekers.point3: Any Go Gulf fee is quoted to you in writing before you pay.

employers.point1: We introduce your requirement to registered recruiting agents we work with.

process.title: How it works: ten steps, two roles
process.lead: Go Gulf helps with the first five steps. A registered recruiting agent handles the rest, with the employer and the authorities.

s1.title: Application
s1.body: You apply for a listed job, or send a general application.

s2.title: Registration
s2.body: Your profile and documents are recorded with us.

s3.title: Counselling
s3.body: We talk through your work, the roles and countries that may suit you, and how the process works.

s4.title: Document preparation
s4.body: We help you put your CV, passport copy, certificates and experience letters in order.

s5.title: Referral
s5.body: With your agreement, we pass your profile to a registered recruiting agent we work with.

s6.title: Shortlisting and interview
s6.body: The recruiting agent shortlists candidates for the employer and arranges the interview.

s7.title: Selection and offer
s7.body: The employer decides who is selected. An offer comes from the employer, through the agent.

s8.title: Medical and attestation
s8.body: Your medical test and document attestation, as the employer and the destination country require.

s9.title: Visa and emigration clearance
s9.body: The recruiting agent processes the visa and the emigration formalities.

s10.title: Departure and joining
s10.body: You travel and join the employer, on the terms of your employment contract.

money.title: How we handle money
money.lead: Rules you can hold us to.
money.rule1: Any Go Gulf fee is quoted to you in writing before you pay. If a fee is not in writing, do not pay it.
money.rule2: Pay Go Gulf only into an account we have confirmed to you in writing. If anyone asks you to pay somewhere else, stop and contact us.
money.rule3: We do not guarantee selection, employment, a visa or a joining date. <terms>See our Terms & conditions</terms>.
money.rule4Title: The agent's charge, with a receipt
money.rule4: A registered recruiting agent collects its statutory service charge itself and gives you a receipt for it.

cta.title: Start with a job — or a question

aboutPage.title: A Lucknow company helping people prepare for Gulf jobs
aboutPage.lead: Go Gulf is a brand of {legalName}, a private limited company incorporated in India on {date}, with its registered office in {place}.

what.title: We work with job seekers and with employers
what.seekers: We list Gulf openings, counsel job seekers, help prepare their profile and documents, and refer them to registered recruiting agents. The agent handles interviews, offers, visa processing and emigration formalities.
what.employers: We introduce your requirement to registered recruiting agents we work with. The agent you engage handles sourcing, selection and visa processing, on its own written terms.
what.role: Go Gulf is not registered as a recruiting agent under the Emigration Act, 1983, and does not itself recruit, select or send anyone abroad. <verify>See our recruiting-agent partners</verify>.

mission.title: Transparency, at every step
mission.body: To help job seekers in India prepare for Gulf jobs and reach registered recruiting agents, through ethical, transparent and technology-driven support.

vision.title: A name you can recognise and trust
vision.body: To become one of the most trusted and recognised names for Gulf career guidance, through honest advice, useful technology and exceptional customer service.

rules.title: Three rules we keep
rules.r1: Any Go Gulf fee is quoted to you in writing before you pay.
rules.r2: We do not guarantee selection, employment, a visa or a joining date.
rules.r3: Our official numbers and addresses are listed on our Verify page. Check there before you act on a message in our name.

employer.body: Send your requirement — roles, headcount, location and timeline — to our business desk. We introduce it to registered recruiting agents we work with.

verifyPage.title: How to check you are dealing with Go Gulf
verifyPage.lead: Before you share documents or pay anything, check these details. Each one can be confirmed independently of us.

company.heading: The company behind Go Gulf
company.body: Go Gulf is a brand of {legalName}. You can look the company up on the Ministry of Corporate Affairs website using its CIN.
company.registration: A CIN shows that a company is incorporated and registered with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs. It identifies the company; it is not a licence for any particular line of business.

channels.heading: Our official contact details
channels.body: If someone claiming to be Go Gulf contacts you from a different number or address, check with us on these details before you act.

payments.heading: Our rules about payments
payments.r1: Any Go Gulf fee is quoted to you in writing before you pay. See <pricing>Pricing & fees</pricing>.
payments.r2: If you are asked to pay an account or a person that we have not confirmed to you in writing, stop and contact us before paying.
payments.r3: We do not guarantee selection, employment, a visa or a joining date. See our <terms>Terms & conditions</terms>.
payments.r4: A registered recruiting agent collects its statutory service charge itself and gives you a receipt. Do not pay it to anyone who cannot give you the agent's receipt.

report.heading: If something does not feel right
report.body: Tell us before you pay or send documents. Email {email} or call {phone}.

partners.heading: Registered recruiting-agent partners
partners.lead: Go Gulf is not registered as a recruiting agent. We counsel candidates, help prepare their documents and refer them to recruiting agents registered under the Emigration Act, 1983. Interviews, offers, visa processing and the agent's statutory service charge are handled by the agent.

candidatesPage.title: Working in the Gulf, step by step
candidatesPage.lead: What Go Gulf does, what your recruiting agent does, the documents you need, the fees, and how to stay safe from fraud.
candidatesPage.whatsappGreeting: Hello Go Gulf, I would like to know how applying works.

steps.title: The ten steps, and who handles each
steps.lead: The first five are with Go Gulf. The rest are with a registered recruiting agent, the employer and the authorities.

documents.title: What you need, and when
documents.lead: You need very little to apply. More documents come later, once an employer has selected you.
documents.apply3: Certificates and experience letters, if you have them
documents.laterNote: Your recruiting agent tells you what each step needs when you reach it.

fees.title: What you pay, and when
fees.lead: Where a Go Gulf service carries a fee, it is quoted to you in writing before you pay. A recruiting agent's charge is separate, and is paid to the agent.
fees.rule1: Any Go Gulf fee is quoted to you in writing before you pay.
fees.rule2: Pay Go Gulf only into an account we have confirmed to you in writing.
fees.rule3: Government, embassy, attestation, medical and travel costs are separate, and are identified to you as such.
fees.rule4: We do not guarantee selection, employment, a visa or a joining date.
fees.rule5: A registered recruiting agent collects its statutory service charge itself, and gives you a receipt. Ask for the receipt every time.

safety.title: How not to be cheated
safety.lead: People sometimes pretend to offer Gulf jobs — or pretend to be us — to take money. These checks protect you.
safety.check1: Our phone and WhatsApp number and our email addresses are listed here and on our Verify page. If someone uses our name from another number, check with us first.
safety.check2Title: Never pay without a written quote
safety.check2: If anyone asks you for money without a written quote from Go Gulf, do not pay.
safety.check3: Go Gulf is a brand of a registered company: look up its CIN on the Ministry of Corporate Affairs website. Check a recruiting agent on the official list of active recruiting agents.
safety.check4: If something does not feel right, tell us before you pay or send documents.

faq.title: Common questions
faq.q1: Does Go Gulf guarantee me a job or a visa?
faq.a1: No. We do not guarantee selection, employment, a visa or a joining date. <terms>Our Terms & conditions</terms> explain this.
faq.q2: How will I know what I have to pay?
faq.a2: Every fee is quoted to you in writing before you pay. If a fee has not been quoted in writing, do not pay it. <pricing>Pricing & fees</pricing> explains how our fees work.
faq.q3: What do I need to apply?
faq.a3: Your CV and a copy of your passport. You can add certificates and experience letters too.
faq.a4: You get a confirmation email with a reference number, and our team contacts you. If your profile suits a role, and you agree, we pass it to the registered recruiting agent handling that role.
faq.q5: Can I ask about a job before I apply?
faq.a5: Yes. Ask us on WhatsApp. If you ask from a job’s page, the job’s reference goes with your message.
faq.q6: How can I check I am really dealing with Go Gulf?
faq.a6: Use only the contact details on our <verify>Verify page</verify>, and look up the company’s CIN on the Ministry of Corporate Affairs website.
faq.q7: Is Go Gulf a recruiting agent?
faq.a7: No. Go Gulf is not registered as a recruiting agent under the Emigration Act, 1983. We counsel you, help prepare your profile and documents, and refer you to registered recruiting agents, who handle interviews, offers, visa processing and emigration formalities. <verify>See our recruiting-agent partners</verify>.

partners.lead: Go Gulf is not a recruiting agent. Interviews, offers, visa processing and emigration formalities are handled by recruiting agents registered under the Emigration Act, 1983.

employersPage.title: Hiring from India? Introduce your requirement
employersPage.lead: Tell us the roles, headcount and timeline. We introduce your requirement to registered recruiting agents we work with. The agent you engage handles sourcing, selection, documentation and visa processing, on its own written terms.

services.title: How we can help
services.lead: Choose what you need, then tell us more in the requirement form.

process.title: How it works
process.s1: You share the trades, headcount, work location and timeline.
process.s2: We introduce your requirement to registered recruiting agents we work with.
process.s3: The agent you choose agrees its terms with you directly, in writing.
process.s4: The agent sources and shortlists candidates and arranges the interviews.
process.s5: You select the candidates you want and issue the offers.
process.s6: The agent handles documentation, visa processing and emigration formalities. Selected candidates then travel and join you.

working.title: What you can expect
working.p1: We introduce requirements to recruiting agents registered under the Emigration Act, 1983. Their details are on our Verify page.
working.p2: Employer requirements go to our business team, separately from candidate enquiries.
working.p3: Sending us a requirement is free. Any terms are agreed in writing before work starts.

form.title: Tell us what you need
form.lead: The more you tell us, the better we can brief the recruiting agents. Fields marked optional can be left blank.
form.asideBody: Our business desk handles employer requirements.
form.noPromise: Introducing a requirement does not mean it will be filled. Hiring decisions and timelines rest with you and the recruiting agent.

servicesPage.title: What Go Gulf does
servicesPage.lead: Counselling and preparation for job seekers, and introductions for employers. Interviews, offers and visa processing are handled by registered recruiting agents. Choose a service and send an enquiry.
servicesPage.seekersLead: Help choosing jobs, preparing your profile and documents, and reaching a registered recruiting agent.
